This file carries the license notices for xterm.js and xterm.css, the
vendored @xterm/xterm 6.0.0 bundle and stylesheet (see the provenance
comment on VENDOR_XTERM_JS in ../../src/lib.rs). The minified bundle has no
room for a header, and until this file existed nothing shipped its notice;
only xterm.css kept a copyright comment of its own.

The package is MIT-licensed. Its bundle also compiles in part of Visual
Studio Code's `vs/base` (43 modules under `out/vs/` in the bundle's source
map, each headed "Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation ... Licensed under the
MIT License. See License.txt in the project root"), and the npm package does
not include that License.txt, so VS Code's MIT notice is reproduced here as
well. The xterm.js text is copied verbatim from the package's LICENSE file
as published to npm; the VS Code text is copied verbatim from LICENSE.txt at
the root of https://github.com/microsoft/vscode.

Certification digests:
- registry tarball @xterm/xterm 6.0.0:
  sha256:908e66e04af6c8dc6b00dd3b54de088e2e81e5ed866284fd6c2fb3c2d1c7a3f6
- retained xterm.js, byte-identical to the tarball's lib/xterm.js:
  sha256:14903579ff54664cd72f8e8699e6961a6272c21863ec1c3b118cdc8af5d4a972

This notice ships inside the distributed bundles, not just beside the
source: XTERM_LICENSES in ../../src/lib.rs declares this file as an asset.
